invariants.name: ES Modules Only
invariants.rule: All internal files use import/export, never require()
invariants.details: ["package.json has \"type\": \"module\"","Exception: Templates distributed to users may use .cjs for compatibility"]

invariants.name: Absolute Paths Required
invariants.rule: Always use path.resolve() for user-provided paths

invariants.name: Graceful Failures
invariants.rule: All commands must handle missing files/directories
invariants.details: ["Show helpful error messages, not stack traces"]

invariants.name: Template Preservation
invariants.rule: AI agents never modify templates during normal workflow
invariants.details: ["Templates in templates/ are deliverables distributed to users","User customization happens in generated files via AI-native onboarding workflow","Exception: Deliberate template maintenance requires implementation plan, TDD, architect review, validation, migration guide","See: .aiknowsys/learned/template-maintenance.md for workflow"]

invariants.name: Template Structure Integrity
invariants.rule: When AI fills CODEBASE_ESSENTIALS.md, NEVER change section headings
invariants.details: ["Replace {{PLACEHOLDERS}} with real values, not generic placeholders","Preserve template structure exactly (don't rename sections)"]

invariants.name: Backwards Compatibility
invariants.rule: Bash scripts in scripts/ must remain functional

invariants.name: Test-Driven Development (TDD) - MANDATORY
invariants.rule: For new features: Write tests BEFORE implementation (RED → GREEN → REFACTOR)
invariants.details: ["For bugfixes: Write test that reproduces bug FIRST, then fix, then refactor","Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle for both features and bugs","Exception: Configuration-only changes (adding properties to const objects)","Full workflow: .github/skills/tdd-workflow/SKILL.md"]

invariants.name: Deliverables Consistency
invariants.rule: Templates (templates/ directory) are deliverables distributed to users
invariants.details: ["ANY change to core functionality MUST update corresponding templates","Templates must match non-template equivalents","Run npx aiknowsys validate-deliverables before commits/releases","Pre-commit hook automatically validates when templates/ changed"]
